edits.new: On a WMT'14 En→De Transformer, the factored version without momentum matched Adam (BLEU 25.4 vs 25.4, with warmup). Without warmup, its β₂ = 0.999 setting collapsed (BLEU 0.2) unless updates were clipped (22.4)

doubts: Paper text (23.6/23.4) and Table 2 (25.6/25.4) disagree for the momentum comparison; I used the table.

edits.old: ranked them by how much more likely the model found the text than zlib compression did, and checked 1,800 candidates by hand.
edits.new: ranked them with six membership-inference scores (the most precise compared the model's likelihood with zlib compression), and checked the top 1,800 candidates by hand.
edits.why: The 1,800 candidates are 100 from each of 3 generation strategies × 6 ranking metrics; zlib is one of the six (172 of the 604 hits came via zlib picks). Sec. 6.1, Table 2.

edits.old: then ranked 600,000 samples by how much more likely the model found them than zlib compression did.
edits.new: then ranked 600,000 samples with six membership-inference scores, the most precise of which compared the model's likelihood with zlib compression.
edits.why: Same: the 1,800 candidates/604 hits pool all six metrics, not zlib alone (Sec. 6.1, Table 2).
